The Problem

Ungoverned AI is Not Production Safe

Enterprises are adding LLMs to real workflows, but prompts, outputs, tenant data, and policy decisions still move without a deterministic control layer.

Policy Bypass Risk

Prompts can ask models to ignore instructions, reveal hidden context, or bypass internal policy controls.

Sensitive Data Exposure

PII, customer identifiers, and regulated data can leave the application before teams have proof that it was checked.

Unvalidated Outputs

LLM responses can break schemas, invent values, or return business numbers that violate approved rate cards.

No Audit Evidence

Security, compliance, and risk teams need traceable decisions, not screenshots or manual review notes after the fact.

The Solution

A Policy-First AI Control Plane

ANSARK places a deterministic governance layer around enterprise AI: every request is authenticated, checked, enforced, validated, logged, and reportable.

Runtime AI Gateway

Intercept AI requests before and after the model call with PII redaction, jailbreak controls, schema validation, numeric checks, and tenant policy enforcement.

Policy Compiler

Convert plain-language access policies into deterministic Cedar, OPA/Rego, Governance YAML, and XACML outputs that engineering teams can enforce.

Compliance Evidence Automation

Use regulatory document extraction as a control source: RBI/DPSS clauses become reviewable controls that feed policy lifecycle and audit workflows.
